content.changeSummary: Optional hard expiry for short links (expiresAt). Expired links answer 410 EXPIRED; stats remain readable; additive SQLite migration to schema v2.
changes: All link responses include expiresAt (null when absent)
GET /:code and GET /api/links/:code return 410 EXPIRED after expiry
Schema v2: links.expires_at (nullable, additive, idempotent migration; H2 and PostgreSQL)
Tests: acceptance (AC-1..AC-5), service fake-clock, repository contract, v1->v2 upgrade

riskAssessment.rationale: Backward-compatible API (optional field), additive schema, read-time enforcement with no new infrastructure, full suite green including migration tests.

rollbackPlan: Leave the expires_at column and schema_version=2 in place; v1 ignores both.
Communicate that links created with an expiry during the window will not expire under v1 until roll-forward.
Roll forward once the issue is fixed; the migration is idempotent so no manual schema work is needed.

checklist.item: Typecheck and full test suite green
Protected-file change approved by a human
Schema migration is additive and tested
openapi.yaml updated for expiresAt and 410 EXPIRED
